meta.title: Community — Verified Student Insights
meta.description: Real experiences from verified students across Europe. Join university and program communities, ask questions, and choose your best path.

hero.heading: Real experiences. Real students. <highlight>Real answers.</highlight>
hero.body: Join university and program communities to ask questions, compare experiences, and choose your best path. Every voice is verified — no spam, no anonymous noise.

actionCards.verifyNote: {action} is for verified students — confirm your university email in the “Become a verified student” card.

ask.heading: Ask the community
ask.body: Stuck on something specific? Drop a question — verified students and responsibles answer fastest when the question is clear and short.

share.heading: Share your experience
share.body: Already studying or graduated? Write a verified review and help the next cohort make a better decision.

errors.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like a valid email address.
errors.freeMail: Personal providers (Gmail, Outlook, …) don't count — use your university address.
errors.notAcademic: We couldn't recognise this as a university domain. Double-check the address.
errors.alreadyVerified: Your account already has a verified university email.
errors.cooldown: We just sent you a link — wait a couple of minutes before requesting another.
errors.sendFailed: We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again.
errors.storageFailed: Something went wrong saving your request. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Please sign in again, then retry.

verify.verifiedBody: You can chat, review, and ask questions across the community.
verify.sentBody: We emailed a confirmation link to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours — check your inbox (and spam).
verify.devModeLabel: Dev mode — email sending not configured
verify.expiredNotice: Your previous link expired — request a new one.
verify.resend: Resend or use a different address
verify.inputVariantNotice: Only verified students can send messages — confirm your university email to join the conversation.
verify.sidebarBody: Everyone can read the community. To write — chat, reviews, questions — confirm a university email address linked to your account.

upgrade.panelMessageDefault: Subscribe to message verified students and EdFind campus responsibles, join group chats, and access detailed program-specific insights.
